description: Crexi commercial real estate listings (for sale and auction) from the JSON search the crexi.com site uses: listing ID, name, short description, property types, status (On-Market, Auction...), asking price (null when unpriced), square footage, brokerage, address with county and coordinates, listed/updated dates, offers-due date and URL, plus the total match count. Filter by US state, property type and keyword. Leases are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Optional keyword, e.g. a city name or 'Dollar General'

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code, e.g. TX

type.description: Optional property type: Retail, Office, Industrial, Multifamily, Hospitality, Land, Mixed Use, Special Purpose, Self Storage, Senior Living, Mobile Home Park, Note/Loan, Business for Sale

name: realestate_commercial_real_estate_listings
title: Realestate Commercial Real Estate Listings
